observations.run: 22 September queue run, second attempt on the correct Search Console profile
observations.inspectedBefore: all ten were inspected first: none was indexed. Seven answered 'Google nu cunoaste adresa URL', three 'Descoperita - nu este indexata'.
observations.note: Each request was confirmed by the dialog 'Indexarea a fost solicitata'. No quota message appeared, so the daily limit was not reached. An accepted request is not an indexed page: the ten pages were still not indexed at the time of the request, and the earlier note of the same day (no access) was written before the correct profile was known.
